assets.name: SM_LSP_Workbench
assets.label: Empty metal workbench
assets.notes: Deck Z=.90; usable 1.60 x .70 m. Empty underframe with real leg and stretcher gaps. Shares footprint and deck height with sink.

assets.name: SM_LSP_Shelf
assets.label: Empty steel shelving rack
assets.notes: Tier tops .12/.72/1.32/1.92 m; inner bay 1.30 x .50 m, vertical clear .545 m. Two .60 x .40 x .40 m crates fit side by side per tier. Place against room perimeter for camera clearance.

assets.name: SM_LSP_Cabinet
assets.label: Low storage cabinet
assets.notes: Sealed decorative cabinet; all drawer, door and handle detail comes from front tile 4. Deck Z=.90; no interaction or internal geometry.

assets.name: SM_LSP_Cart
assets.label: Rolling utility cart
assets.notes: Top deck Z=.735 and lower deck Z=.175; handle top Z=.85. Four static 8-side wheels; no physics or movement feature. Sample tray fits both decks.

assets.name: SM_LSP_Chair
assets.label: Low-back work chair
assets.notes: Seat Z=.45, low back Z=.80; clipped-corner seat and back for top-down readability. No arms, upholstery seams or interactive feature.

assets.name: SM_LSP_ControlBox
assets.label: Wall control enclosure
assets.notes: Rear-bottom wall pivot Y=0. Gauge and warning details are front atlas graphics.

assets.name: SM_LSP_Analyzer
assets.label: Large laboratory analyzer
assets.notes: Real .76 m wide intake, .375 m high above landing deck; sloped screen console. No gameplay or internal mechanisms.

assets.name: SM_LSP_Sink
assets.label: Laboratory sink counter
assets.notes: Counter Z=.90 matches Workbench; total height includes faucet. Basin opening .55 x .42 m; basin depth .25 m. No full collision hull across basin.

assets.name: SM_LSP_SampleTray
assets.label: Six sample bottles and tray
assets.notes: Detached .45 x .30 tray for shelves/counters. Six opaque pale bottles with teal caps and front atlas labels save transparency passes; no liquid/interior geometry.

assets.name: SM_LSP_Pallet
assets.label: Empty wooden pallet
notes: Deck top Z=0.15 m; center a BoxBundle here or place two SupplyCrates side by side.
Four-way fork clearance: Y approach has two 0.375 m-wide openings; X approach has two 0.275 m-wide openings. Both have 0.080 m clear height.
Twenty box collision pieces preserve deck gaps and fork passages. Nails and wood wear are texture-only.

assets.name: SM_LSP_SupplyCrate
assets.label: Sealed supply crate
notes: Stack at 0.40 m pitch. Corner caps provide aligned bearing faces; lid stays inset.
Two crates span 1.20 m across a rack tier with at least 1.28 m clear width; depth 0.40 m fits its at least 0.48 m usable depth.
One convex box collision is suitable for this sealed solid prop. Latches, recessed handles, labels and lid markings are texture detail only.
Independent environment prop; existing loot crate assets, blueprints and gameplay remain untouched.

assets.name: SM_LSP_BoxBundle
assets.label: Supply box bundle (three cartons)
notes: Three differently sized upright closed cartons, joined as one prop with bottom-centered pivot.
Center on the pallet at Z=0.15 m: margins are 0.10 m in X and 0.15 m in Y; overall loaded height is 0.85 m.
This pallet bundle exceeds rack tier depth; use separate SupplyCrates and SampleTray for shelf loads.
Three box collision pieces follow the stepped profile. Shipping labels appear on -Y faces only; tape, folds and wear are baked atlas detail.
